SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER = 'KRILJI0006' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND RQDT.SO_CA_FLAG = 'SO' AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND TRIM(RQDT.ATOB_DATE) IS NOT NULL AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQDT.REF_NO AS MANDT , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.PLANT AS PLANT , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , QTDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE / 100 AS UNIT_PRICE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE+QTDT.LEAD_TIME,'YYYYMMDD') AS DS_DATE , QTDT.LEAD_TIME AS DS_DAY , RQDT.ATOB_REMARK AS REMARK , DECODE(RQDT.RECV_FLAG,'GD','D','C') AS STATUS , 'S' AS IF_FLAG , RQDT.ATOB_DATE AS IF_DATE , RQDT.ATOB_TIME AS IF_TIME FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' ) WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT RQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
